ReportItem.Name: SQL injection
ReportItem.Description: A SQL injection vulnerability has been discovered in the login page. An attacker can inject malicious SQL statements to extract sensitive data from the database.
ReportItem.DetailedInformation: URL: http://192.168.1.100/login Parameter: username Type: Boolean-based blind Payload: admin' AND 1=1--
ReportItem.Recommendation: Use parameterized queries or prepared statements. Validate all user input.

ReportItem.Name: Cross-site scripting
ReportItem.Description: A reflected XSS vulnerability exists in the search functionality. An attacker can inject malicious JavaScript code that will be executed in the victim's browser.
ReportItem.Recommendation: Encode all user-supplied output. Implement Content-Security-Policy headers.

ReportItem.Name: Unencrypted HTTP login
ReportItem.Description: The login form submits credentials over an unencrypted HTTP connection.
ReportItem.Recommendation: Implement HTTPS and redirect all HTTP requests to HTTPS.

ReportItem.Name: Directory listing enabled
ReportItem.Description: Directory listing is enabled on the /images/ directory, exposing the file structure.
ReportItem.Recommendation: Disable directory listing in the web server configuration.

ReportItem.Name: Apache Tomcat AJP Ghostcat
ReportItem.Description: The Apache Tomcat AJP connector is vulnerable to file read/include attacks (Ghostcat).
ReportItem.Recommendation: Upgrade Tomcat to 9.0.31+. Disable AJP if not needed.
